title: Hypnotic Mindlessness
description:
Empty Your Mind | 7 Minute Hypnosis For Busy Minds

Your mind has been running all day… and it’s exhausted.

Right here, right now, there is nothing that needs to be done. Nothing to solve, nothing to carry, nothing to think about. Goddess Amethyst takes your busy mind and quiets it… word by word… until there’s nothing left but the soft, empty pleasure of being mindless for her.

You love the quiet, don’t you? Yesss… of course you do.

Press play, put the day down, and sink. The world will still be there when you get back… but you’ll be lighter without it.

Subscribe to Goddess Amethyst for more deep trance sessions, and let her empty your mind again and again.
author: Mistress Amethyst
